name: Aldmoor
notes: The northern capital; a navy yard and an arsenal sit inside it under different ministries.

name: Brenn Junction
notes: The western branch breaks gauge here.

name: Kestrel Haven
notes: The North's naval base and yard.

name: Westwatch
notes: West of the salient: the western army's ground.

name: Eastwatch
notes: East of the salient: the eastern army's ground.

name: Harrow Bulge
notes: The tip of the South's salient, between the two northern armies.

name: Wending Valley
notes: The western flank route runs down this valley.

name: Corran Crossing
notes: The direct route crosses the Mere here, under Corran Fort.

name: Gullhaven Shore
notes: Southern batteries cover the approach to Gull Rock.

name: Gull Rock
notes: A northern fort in southern waters, reached only by sea: the joint relief case.

name: Port Sanctuary
notes: A neutral port that runners use.
